experts.district: chart-districts, insight:national, insight:thin — multi-valued Arabic district names mapped to Hebrew; 'قطري' (national) shown as its own row
experts.employer: chart-inst, insight:inst — institute names mapped from Arabic to their Hebrew names; an unmapped name is counted under 'מכונים אחרים', never printed
experts.expert: kpi:experts — used only to drop nameless rows and shifted rows (an organisation name in the expert column), and to merge an expert listed several times into one; no individual is named on the page
experts.adress: skip: street address — contact detail, kept off the page by policy
experts.authority: chart-cities, insight:cities — multi-valued; Arabic city names mapped to Hebrew, spelling variants merged, unmapped names counted under 'אחר'
experts.cell_phone: skip: mobile phone number — contact detail
experts.profession: chart-prof, chart-districts, chart-cities, chart-topics, chart-rates, chart-opinion, insight:prof, insight:rates, insight:op_prof — Arabic profession names mapped to Hebrew; two professions count under the first
experts.opinion: kpi:experts — near-constant 'نعم'; the number marked as giving opinions is stated in the lede
experts.payment: chart-rates, chart-opinion, kpi:rate, kpi:opinion, insight:rates, insight:opinion, insight:op_prof — Arabic free text parsed into an hourly/session rate and an opinion fee (rule stated on the chart)
experts.notes: chart-topics, insight:topics — Arabic keyword tagging only; the free text itself (which carries private e-mails) never reaches the page
experts.languages: chart-langs, kpi:arabic, insight:arabic, insight:langs — multi-valued Arabic language names mapped to Hebrew
